short_description: Jump into the spirit of the season with hands-on animal encounters, crafts, games, and family-friendly fun!
meeting_point: 6447 Helen Woodward Way, Rancho Santa Fe CA 92067
location_address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067
pricing:
Pricing is set per child and adult, so total costs vary based on final group size.
* Infants and children in strollers who are not participating in festival activities are admitted for free.

When booking, do you best estimation of child and adult head count. Day of, we will do a final head count and settle total costs.
description: Enjoy a family skele-fun celebration at the Howl-O-Ween Harvest Family Festival on the Humane Education Campus. Kids and adults can meet animal ambassadors in themed attire, visit trick-or-treat and craft stations, try face painting, explore a mini pumpkin patch, and test their courage in mildly haunted rooms. The event mixes hands-on animal encounters with music, games and seasonal activities to create a playful, spooky atmosphere for toddlers through elementary ages.

what_is_included_items.value: Haunted activities in a few rooms for young learners
Trick-or-treat stations at most main activity areas
Interactive animal encounters with a variety of species
Seasonal craft stations to unleash creativity and take home your artwork
Whimsical face painting that brings out the spirit of the season
Miniature pumpkin patch where each child can take one home
Animal-themed playground to safely play to your full potential
Festive, themed music throughout the event

what_is_not_included_items.value: Food and drinks aren't provided. We have drinking fountains and water bottle refill stations onsite.

itinerary: Event starts at 9am and ends at 1pm. We advise giving yourself at least 1-2 hours to enjoy all the activities available. You do the activities in whatever order suits you best!
highlights:
* Hands-on animal encounters with ambassadors in festive attire
* Trick-or-treat and craft stations for children
* Mildly haunted rooms suitable for young audiences
* Face painting, games and seasonal music throughout the event
highlight_title: A fun fall festival for the whole family!
highlight_description: Animal encounters, costumes, crafts, activities, playground access, face painting, mini pumpkins, and trick-or-treat stations. Perfect for toddlers through elementary-aged children and their families.
check_in_details:
* Please enter the gate to the side of the lobby, there will be signs helping direct you to the registration booth. We will scan the QR codes of the tickets sent to you in your confirmation email.
* Tickets can be purchased ahead of time or at any point morning of and during the event, but all purchasing and registration is done online through the software.
* We will give you a red wrist band if you did not agree to the media policy.

what_to_bring_items.value: Phone or camera to take pictures of the animals!

special_requirements:
* Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
* Children must be accompanied by an adult. Must book at least one adult to proceed with booking children.
restrictions:
* **Shoes**: For safety reasons, closed-toed shoes only. No sandals allowed.
* **Drawstrings**: For safety reasons, drawstrings (hoodies, pants or shorts) should not be worn on the playground.
* **Pets**: No pets are allowed on the campgrounds. There are no exceptions to this safety policy. Cannot leave pets alone in vehicles.
* **Toys, books, stuffed animals, etc.**: These may get soiled, broken, or lost—best to leave at home.
* **Sharp objects**: For safety purposes please leave anything that is a sharp or hazardous at home.
disclaimers: * Species may vary depending on animal health and availability.
